column1: # Talk to a Britain resident. Seeded with a save standing south of the NPC.
# Seeded rather than walked to. The walk-up form of this scenario scripted its
# way in from the town gate, and the resident walks its own schedule while
# those steps run, so the two sides arrived with it in different cells and
# every later beat compared unrelated windows (`cleak/u5-engine#22`).
# `qa/tools/reseed.py` replayed that walk once into the seed named below.
# A lottery on the stranger-introduction coin. `conversation.md` §9: on first
# meeting the dispatcher "assigns the transformed value as the shared
# random-generator state, and immediately flips a fair coin. On one outcome the
# conversation simply proceeds to the keyword prompt with nothing said after
# the description. On the other the NPC introduces itself" with `I am called`.
# The section names this as "one of the sites that re-seeds the generator from"
# the host clock, so the two sides cannot agree except by luck.
# Measured: the beats differ by the presence of the `"I am called <name>"` row
# and nothing else. A run whose two sides flipped differently has measured the
# coin, not the engine, and must be re-run.
